records.evidence_phrase: 2026 BHA Features Racing/Fixtures The British Horseracing Authority has today confirmed that two upcoming fixtures scheduled to take place at Chelmsford City Racecourse have been transferred to Southwell. The fixtures are scheduled for the evenings of 8 October and 15 October and will remain on the same date. The race programmes for both fixtures will be available to view on Racing Admin in due course. Notes to editors: 1. For further information on these changes please contact the BHA Racing Department on 0207 152 0050 or via [email protected] . Welcome to our new website! Like any new website you might come across things that need fixing, please let us know and we will get these resolved as quickly as possible. In the meantime, we would love to hear your feedback. Email us at [email protected] to tell us what you think. We hope you enjoy the new site. Don't show this message again.
